name: algorithmic-prompting
description: Partition work into broad parallel lanes with minimal task splitting, then schedule lane DAGs across worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Plan parallel worktrees and draft bounded agent prompts.
interface.longDescription: Partition implementation goals into the fewest broad lanes that expose safe parallelism; default to one worktree, branch, task, and coding-agent prompt per lane; derive a collapsed lane DAG; avoid unnecessary microtasks; and advance work through human-approved Kahn scheduling.
interface.defaultPrompt: Partition this goal into the fewest broad lanes that maximize safe parallel work, default to one task and coding-agent prompt per lane, show concise lane cards and a collapsed Mermaid DAG, and guide manual Kahn execution.
